scripts.dev: concurrently -n "WEB,API,AI-ORCH" -c "magenta,green,cyan" "pnpm --filter @ai-lmc/web dev" "go -C backend-core run ./cmd/server" "python -m uvicorn --app-dir ai-orchestrator main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000"
scripts.test:web: pnpm --filter @ai-lmc/web test || echo Web test not configured
scripts.test: pnpm test:api && pnpm test:ai && pnpm test:gpu
scripts.push: git add . && git commit -m "chore: update otomatis" && git push origin main
